examples.arabic: نور كان عندها كيكة صغيرة عملتها أمها.
examples.english: Nour had a small cake her mother made.
examples.storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

examples.arabic: انا عملت كيكة حلوة عشان عيلتك
examples.english: I made a nice cake for your family.
examples.transliteration: ana amalt kika helwa ashan eiltak

examples.arabic: احنا اكلنا كيكة حلوة مع بعض
examples.transliteration: ehna akalna kika helwa maa baad

examples.english: She gave him a plate of hot cake.

examples.arabic: جدتي كانت بتدوق الكيكة بفرحة وباين عليها مبسوطة اوي
examples.english: My grandmother was tasting the cake with joy, and she looked very happy
examples.transliteration: Gaddatī kānet bitdū' el-kīka bi-farḥa w-bāyin 3alēha mabsūṭa awī

examples.arabic: باباها شاف الكيكة وضحك وقال مين ساب الشمع مولع
examples.english: Her dad saw the cake and laughed, saying, "Who left the candles burning?"
examples.transliteration: babaha shaf el keika we dehek we 'al min saab el shama3 mola3
